description: This file is a shell script for managing platform-specific upgrade procedures in an OpenWrt-based system, particularly for i.MX boards. It includes functions for enabling image metadata checks, verifying supported images, performing upgrades, copying configurations, and pre-upgrade steps, with board-specific logic embedded in case statements.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata validation for specific boards based on their name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the given image is supported on the current board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade process depending on the board type, either via NAND or SD card.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration needed for specific boards during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs pre-upgrade steps such as preparing SD card upgrades for specific boards.
